description: This file defines the HandlerStack class in the GuzzleHttp library, which manages middleware stacking for HTTP request handling, including creation, manipulation, and invocation of handler stacks.

classes.name: HandlerStack
classes.description: A class for creating and managing a stack of middleware functions for handling HTTP requests and responses.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a default handler stack with common middleware for error handling, redirects, cookies, and body preparation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the handler stack with an optional underlying HTTP handler.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes the handler stack with a given request and options, returning a response or promise.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the handler stack for debugging.

methods.name: setHandler
methods.description: Sets the underlying HTTP handler function that returns a promise.

methods.name: hasHandler
methods.description: Checks if the handler stack has a handler set.

methods.name: unshift
methods.description: Adds a middleware to the bottom of the stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a middleware to the top of the stack.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Inserts a middleware before another middleware by name.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Inserts a middleware after another middleware by name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a middleware from the stack by instance or name.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Combines all middleware and the handler into a single callable for execution.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds the index of a middleware in the stack by its name.

methods.name: splice
methods.description: Inserts a middleware into the stack at a specific position relative to another middleware.

methods.name: debugCallable
methods.description: Returns a string representation for debugging a callable.
